{{Quote|For your bravery, I bestow upon you the rank of warrior and the Sacred Horn of the Soul Trees.|translated=1|Chirpa to Teebo|<ref name="E:SOE" />}}
The '''Sacred Horn of the Soul Trees''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] artifact. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], that [[Horn/Legends|horn]] was bestowed to the newly-anointed warrior [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], as a reward for his bravery in fighting the [[Griagh]]. It had a connection with the [[Soul Tree]]s,<ref name="E:SOE" /> which the Ewoks held sacred.<ref name="AGTSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> Teebo still owned the Sacred Horn eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, when the Ewoks helped the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] fight the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on and in orbit of Endor.<ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
